title: The egress gateway: per-session allowlist, the global ceiling and rate limits
design_ref: Network: default deny and one way out
purpose: Show the gateway allowing what a session is approved for, refusing everything else, being capped by the network ceiling even when an allowlist is wrong, and rate limiting a runaway session.

steps.display: orch create egr coding python-untrusted 900 example.com
orch create egr coding python-untrusted 900 github.com
kubectl -n sandbox-egress exec <gateway pod> -- python -c "connect to pypi.org:443, then github.com:443"   # the gateway's own network, no sandbox involved
steps.output:
pypi.org -> connected
github.com -> TimeoutError: timed out

checks.description: a host on the allowlist (pypi.org) is reachable through the gateway
checks.because: The gateway matched pypi.org against the session's allowlist and tunnelled the connection.

checks.description: a host not on the allowlist (api.github.com) is refused with 403
checks.because: The gateway answers CONNECT with 403 before any connection to the host is opened.

checks.description: example.com is refused for session A because A did not ask for it
example.com is reachable for session B, which was approved for it
checks.because: Same sandbox image, same network; only the session's allowlist differs.

checks.description: a session allowlist naming a host outside the network ceiling still cannot reach it (not a 403: the gateway tried and the network refused)
checks.because: The gateway's own network policy lists only the approved domains, so a mistake in a session allowlist cannot open the internet.

checks.description: the gateway ALLOWED the github.com request for session C (so the allowlist did not stop it); the network ceiling did
checks.because: The audit record shows an allow decision; the connection still never completed, which only the gateway's network policy can explain.

checks.description: from the gateway's own pod, pypi.org connects and github.com does not (so the network ceiling is what stops it)
checks.because: Same pod, same moment, same internet route. Only the destination's presence in the gateway's network policy differs.

checks.description: a session that opens 140 tunnels in a minute is cut off at the rate limit
checks.because: The gateway allows 120 requests per minute per session; it refused 20.

checks.description: the gateway logged both allow and deny decisions for the session
checks.because: Every decision is written with the session ID.

notes: Session A is created with the template's default allowlist: pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org and two internal hosts.
